name: Engineer / Specialist in Humanities / International Services
summary: The status of residence most foreign graduates work in Japan on. An employer in Japan contracts you for work that needs specialist knowledge from the sciences or the humanities, or a foreign culture's outlook. You qualify through a university degree in a related subject, a specialist course at a Japanese vocational school, ten years of experience or a listed information-processing qualification, and the pay has to match what a Japanese national doing the same work would get.

requirements.text: You need a contract with a public or private organisation in Japan, so the job offer comes first.

sources.quote: 本邦の公私の機関との契約に基づいて行う理学、工学その他の自然科学の分野若しくは法律学、経済学、社会学その他の人文科学の分野に属する技術若しくは知識を要する業務
sources.translation: Work requiring technology or knowledge in the fields of science, engineering or other natural sciences, or of jurisprudence, economics, sociology or other humanities, performed on the basis of a contract with a public or private organisation in Japan

requirements.text: The work has to need technical or specialist knowledge from the natural sciences or the humanities, or thought and sensitivity based on a foreign culture.

sources.quote: 又は外国の文化に基盤を有する思考若しくは感受性を必要とする業務に従事する活動
sources.translation: Or activities engaging in work requiring thought or sensitivity grounded in a foreign culture

sources.quote: 該当例としては、機械工学等の技術者、通訳、デザイナー、私企業の語学教師、マーケティング業務従事者等。
sources.translation: Examples include: engineers in fields such as mechanical engineering, interpreters, designers, language teachers at private companies, persons engaged in marketing work, and so on.

requirements.text: You qualify if you graduated from university in a subject related to the work, or had education at an equivalent or higher level.

sources.quote: 当該技術若しくは知識に関連する科目を専攻して大学を卒業し、又はこれと同等以上の教育を受けたこと。
sources.translation: Having graduated from a university having majored in subjects related to the technology or knowledge concerned, or having received education equivalent to or above that.

requirements.text: Without a related degree you can qualify instead with a specialist course at a Japanese vocational school, if that course meets requirements the Minister of Justice has published, or with ten years of practical experience, which counts the years you studied the subject at school or university.

sources.quote: 当該技術又は知識に関連する科目を専攻して本邦の専修学校の専門課程又は専攻科を修了（当該修了に関し法務大臣が告示をもって定める要件に該当する場合に限る。）したこと。
sources.translation: Having completed a specialist course or an advanced course at a vocational school in Japan having majored in subjects related to the technology or knowledge concerned (limited to cases where that completion meets the requirements specified by public notice of the Minister of Justice).

sources.quote: 十年以上の実務経験（大学、高等専門学校、高等学校、中等教育学校の後期課程又は専修学校の専門課程若しくは専攻科において当該技術又は知識に関連する科目を専攻した期間を含む。）を有すること。
sources.translation: Having ten or more years of practical experience (including the period spent majoring in subjects related to the technology or knowledge concerned at a university, a college of technology, a high school, the latter course of a secondary school, or a specialist or advanced course of a vocational school).

requirements.text: For information-processing work, passing an examination or holding a qualification that the Minister of Justice has listed takes the place of the education and experience test.

sources.quote: 情報処理に関する技術又は知識を要する業務に従事しようとする場合で、法務大臣が告示をもって定める情報処理技術に関する試験に合格し又は法務大臣が告示をもって定める情報処理技術に関する資格を有しているときは、この限りでない。
sources.translation: Where the person intends to engage in work requiring technology or knowledge relating to information processing, and has passed an examination relating to information processing technology specified by public notice of the Minister of Justice, or holds a qualification relating to information processing technology specified by public notice of the Minister of Justice, the foregoing shall not apply.

requirements.text: If the job is the foreign-culture kind, such as translation, interpreting, language teaching, public relations, advertising, overseas trade, clothing or interior design, or product development, you also need three years of relevant experience, unless you are a university graduate doing translation, interpreting or language teaching.

sources.quote: 翻訳、通訳、語学の指導、広報、宣伝又は海外取引業務、服飾若しくは室内装飾に係るデザイン、商品開発その他これらに類似する業務に従事すること。
sources.translation: Engaging in translation, interpreting, language instruction, public relations, publicity or overseas trade business, design relating to clothing or interior decoration, product development, or other work similar to these.

sources.quote: 従事しようとする業務に関連する業務について三年以上の実務経験を有すること。ただし、大学を卒業した者が翻訳、通訳又は語学の指導に係る業務に従事する場合は、この限りでない。
sources.translation: Having three or more years of practical experience in work related to the work the person intends to engage in. However, where a person who has graduated from a university engages in work relating to translation, interpreting or language instruction, the foregoing shall not apply.

requirements.text: The employer has to pay you at least what a Japanese national doing the same work would be paid.

sources.quote: 日本人が従事する場合に受ける報酬と同等額以上の報酬を受けること。
sources.translation: Receiving remuneration equal to or above the remuneration a Japanese national would receive were they to engage in the same work.

requirements.text: Coming from outside Japan means a Certificate of Eligibility is applied for first, and you use it to get the visa.

sources.quote: 在留資格認定証明書交付申請
sources.translation: Application for issuance of a Certificate of Eligibility

sources.quote: 新しくこの在留資格で日本への入国を希望する場合の申請です。
sources.translation: This is the application for those who wish to newly enter Japan under this status of residence.

requirements.text: Ask the employer which immigration category it falls into. An employer with no document for a higher category counts as Category 4, and the language rule below applies to Category 3 and 4.

sources.quote: 上記カテゴリーのいずれかに該当することを証明する文書　適宜（提出可能な書類がない場合は、カテゴリー４に該当することとなります。）
sources.translation: A document proving that one of the above categories applies, as appropriate (where there is no document that can be submitted, Category 4 will be taken to apply).

sources.quote: 令和８年４月１５日（水）以降の申請から、カテゴリー３又は４に該当する場合は、以下の添付書類を追加で提出いただく必要があります。
sources.translation: For applications from Wednesday 15 April Reiwa 8 onward, where Category 3 or 4 applies, the following attachments must additionally be submitted.

requirements.text: If the employer is in Category 3 or 4 and the job is mainly customer-facing work that uses language skills, the application has to include proof of CEFR B2 ability in the language you use at work.

sources.quote: 令和８年４月１５日（水）以降の申請から、カテゴリー３又は４に該当する場合は、以下の添付書類を追加で提出いただく必要があります。
sources.translation: For applications from Wednesday 15 April Reiwa 8 onward, where Category 3 or 4 applies, the following attachments must additionally be submitted.

sources.quote: （主に言語能力を用いて対人業務等に従事する場合）業務上使用する言語について、ＣＥＦＲ・Ｂ２相当の言語能力を有することを証する資料
sources.translation: (Where mainly engaging in interpersonal work and the like using language ability) Materials proving that the person has language ability equivalent to CEFR B2 in the language used in the course of work

sources.quote: 申請職種が「翻訳・通訳」やホテルフロント業務等の「接客」
sources.translation: Where the applied-for job type is "translation and interpreting", or "customer service" such as hotel front desk work

requirements.text: You already count as CEFR B2 in Japanese if you hold JLPT N2 or above, scored 400 or more on the BJT business Japanese test, lived in Japan 20 years or more as a mid to long term resident, graduated from a Japanese university or finished a Japanese college or vocational specialist course, or finished compulsory education in Japan and then graduated from high school.

sources.quote: 注１：以下に該当する場合は、ＣＥＦＲ・Ｂ２相当の日本語能力を有するものとみなします。
sources.translation: Note 1: Where the following apply, the person shall be deemed to have Japanese language ability equivalent to CEFR B2.

sources.quote: ＪＬＰＴ・Ｎ２以上を取得していること
sources.translation: Having obtained JLPT N2 or above

sources.quote: ＢＪＴビジネス日本語能力テストにおいて４００点以上を取得していること
sources.translation: Having obtained 400 points or above in the BJT Business Japanese Proficiency Test

sources.quote: 中長期在留者として２０年以上本邦に在留していること
sources.translation: Having resided in Japan for 20 years or more as a mid-to-long-term resident

sources.quote: 本邦の大学を卒業し、又は本邦の高等専門学校若しくは専修学校の専門課程若しくは専攻科を修了していること
sources.translation: Having graduated from a university in Japan, or having completed a specialist course or an advanced course at a college of technology or a vocational school in Japan

sources.quote: 我が国の義務教育を修了し高等学校を卒業していること
sources.translation: Having completed this country's compulsory education and graduated from high school
